opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Trust contributes 100% of salary up to £56,000 in year one, 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three; plus up to £6,000 per annum research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; must hold a doctorate by take-up; must hold a UK degree or a UK academic position
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness and medical applications

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas; applications made by a member of academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness and medical applications

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers based at UK universities, other institutions of higher education, and (on a trial basis) UK independent research institutes/organisations
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project. Outline stage is paused; detailed applications are open for invited applicants.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical, policy, commercial, database-assembly research

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post; live in the UK for a minimum of 26 weeks per year and hold/have held a post at a UK university or eligible research organisation
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness and medical applications

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the Fellowship duration; resident in the UK
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness and medical applications

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million over up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students and holding their own research degree awarding powers
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship
discipline_tags: Any topic in the Trust's remit

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented early career scholars at UK universities with research degree awarding powers; at least two years post-PhD experience; permanent academic appointment at lecturer level or equivalent
opportunities.summary: For talented scholars embarking on a university career to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem
discipline_tags: Any research area except medical/clinical, policy, commercial, database-assembly research
